lead: A calendar of events with day, week and month views. Day and week are time grids: all-day and multi-day events run as bars along the top, timed events sit as blocks below, overlapping ones side by side, and today has a current-time line. The month view has one week per row, multi-day events span several columns, and what doesn't fit collapses into "+n more". The caller owns the events and the view state; dates and times are strings without a time zone.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: The week view is the default. Click a day header to open that day; the controls at the top right switch the view, page back and forth, or return to today.

interactive.title: Interactive
interactive.description: With `onEventClick`, events are buttons. With `onSlotClick`, clicking empty space in the time grid gives the date and the time rounded to half an hour (only the date in the month view).
interactive.hint: Click an event or an empty slot.

drag.title: Drag and Resize
drag.description: With `onEventChange`, events can be dragged: drag a block to move it (to another day or time), drag its top or bottom edge to change its length, and drag all-day bars and month-view events to other dates; Esc cancels. Keyboard: focus an event, then Alt + arrow keys move it and Alt + Shift + Up / Down change its end time.
drag.hint: Drag an event, or drag a block's top or bottom edge.

month.title: Month
month.description: Multi-day events are bars across several columns, timed single-day events are dots; what doesn't fit in a day collapses into "+n more", which opens that day.

range.title: Hours and Locale
range.description: `startHour` / `endHour` limit the hours shown. Texts and date formats follow the language set in the page header (ConfigProvider); `locale` / `labels` passed to the component win over the app's. This one deliberately uses the other language.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The root; `data-view` is the current view
styling.header: The header: the title (`aria-live`), the view switcher and previous / today / next
styling.controls: Wrappers of the view switcher (Segmented) and the navigation buttons (Button)
styling.heads: Day headers of the day / week views; `data-today`, `data-weekend`
styling.allday: The all-day / multi-day event area, not rendered when there are no such events; events are placed with `--seg-col` / `--seg-span` / `--seg-row`
styling.grid: The time grid: scroll area, hour labels on the left, columns. A column is `role=group` with `data-today`, `data-weekend`; theme styles draw the hour lines as backgrounds, `--agenda-hours` is the number of hours and `--agenda-cols` the number of columns
styling.event: An event. `data-kind` is `block` (in the time grid: `--ev-start` / `--ev-length` in minutes, `--ev-col` / `--ev-cols` for overlap columns), `bar` (all-day / multi-day) or `chip` (a timed single-day event in the month view); `data-color`; `data-continues-before` / `data-continues-after` mark an event that goes on beyond this segment
styling.handle: When draggable: the resize handles on a block's top and bottom edges (`data-edge` is `start` / `end`), and the screen reader announcement (visually hidden). Events carry `data-draggable`, the dragged event `data-dragging`, and so does the root
styling.month: The month view: one row per week; `--agenda-lanes` is the number of event rows the week uses
styling.day: A day cell of the month view (`data-today` / `data-outside` / `data-weekend`), its date button, and "+n more"
styling.reused: The header's navigation buttons and view switcher, styled by the Button and Segmented theme styles
